newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular buys 80 pct of firm.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular buys 80 pct of firm.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Tuesday it had acquired 80 percent of Advanced Telecommunications Inc, with an effective accounting date of May 1.
Applied Cellular said it expects the transaction to add $10-$12 million in revenues and $600,000 to $1.0 million in net income over the coming year.
Applied Cellular is a specialty telecommuniations company.
Advanced Telecommunications, headquartered in Naperville, Ill., installs telecommunications equipment and voice messaging/voice response systems, and distributes voice and data network services.
Advanced Telecommunications has achieved consistent growth and profitability over the past 14 years, Applied Cellular said.
